=== BLOFIN PERPETUALS — 10-MIN AUTONOMOUS TRADING CRON (BROWSER MODE) ===

🔴 MODE (user directive 2026-09-21): THE PRIVATE API KEY IS DEAD (152401, server-side revocation — never re-diagnose, never retry private REST). TRADE THROUGH THE BLOFIN SCREEN IN THE USER'S **CHROME BROWSER** (logged-in session):
- Use `computer_use` with NATIVE capture/input on the REAL Chrome window (find pid/window_id via `list_windows`, app "chrome.exe"). Navigate/click/type via element index or coordinates from `capture(mode='som'/'vision')`.
- Do NOT use the driver-owned isolated browser (no cookies → login wall). Do NOT use the KnightTrader/BloHunter apps. Do NOT try to re-sign private API calls.
- PUBLIC market data (tickers/candles/instruments) still works via the existing tick script pipeline — keep using it for scanning.
- If the Chrome Blofin tab is logged out / shows a login or 2FA wall → STOP, HOLD, report blocker. Never interact with login/2FA/payment dialogs.
- If account state (equity/positions) is unreadable in the UI → HOLD + report. Blind trading forbidden.

=== EXECUTION ORDER (every tick) ===
1) Read lessons file: C:\Users\mknig\AppData\Roaming\knight-trader\hermes\lessons\blofin_live_trading.md — apply prior rules.
2) PUBLIC SCAN via tick script: `C:/Users/mknig/AppData/Local/Programs/Python/Python312/python.exe "C:/Users/mknig/AppData/Roaming/knight-trader/hermes/scripts/blofin_tick.py"` (curl_cffi chrome impersonation; if 403 HTML → Camoufox headless fallback for public data only). It proves the public pipe, scans top ~38 liquid names, applies gates.
3) ACCOUNT STATE via Chrome Blofin screen: capture the Chrome window, read equity + open positions + any TP/SL shown. Verify what the UI shows against the scan.
4) If a gate FULLY fires (R:R>=2, vol confirmed, SL >= 0.5% from entry, RR<5 — huge RR = stop too tight): place the trade IN THE CHROME BLOFIN UI — set leverage, size (alloc = avail*0.10/2), entry, TP and SL attached. Screenshot-verify the order confirmation and the position+TP/SL appearing in the UI. Max 1 new entry per tick.
5) If NO gate fires → HOLD. Never force an entry. Discipline > activity.
6) Manage open positions via UI: attached TP/SL does the exiting; only tighten SL to breakeven or cut if structure breaks. If any position shows NO TP/SL in the UI, protect or close it immediately (reduce-only market).
7) Mental-trade log for oversold/overbought/notable names (entry/TP/SL/R:R + trigger) — follow to completion across ticks.
8) APPEND this tick's decision + mental log + any new rule to the lessons file. Keep the equity curve vertical.

=== STRATEGY GATES (unchanged) ===
Universe: GET https://openapi.blofin.com/api/v1/market/tickers?instType=SWAP (~493 syms; vol>=500k = liquid, deep-dive top ~40 by 24h vol). Resample 1m→5m/15m/1h; RSI(14), EMA20, ATR(14), volume ratio = last-bar vol / 20-bar SMA. Use complete bars ([-2]), last bar is forming.
- LONG_MR: 1h RSI<32-35 + price >1.0-1.2 ATR below 1h EMA20 + 5m bull_body + 5m RSI turning up + vr5>1.3 + R:R>=2 (TP=1h EMA20, SL below 5m swing low).
- SHORT_CONT: 15m TRUE stepped lower-highs + RSI 35-70 + vr15>1.0-1.3 + R:R>=2 + 1h dist between -2.0 and +2.0 ATR (no counter-trend shorts into pumps; 5m microstructure must be bearish).
- BO_LONG: 5m close > 20-bar high + vr5>1.4 + R:R>=2, SL below entry (hi20*0.99 floor 2%).
- BD_SHORT: 5m close < 20-bar low + vr5>0.9 + R:R>=2.
- Priority: BO > MR > CONT > BD. Iterate candidates[] — skip ones already in position.
HARD REJECTS: capitulation flushes (no 5m bull turn), micro-cap pumps >15% on thin vol, R:R<2 bounces already happened, shorts at 1h RSI>70 (wait for cool to 35-70 + stepped LHs), SL < 0.5% from entry (1% for sub-0.01 pairs), RR>5 (= stop too tight, 1000BONK lesson).

=== SIZING / ACCOUNT ===
- alloc = available * 0.10 / 2 (≈5% of avail per trade). Leverage <=5x. Verify size from live account state each tick.
- brokerId 5388cb1f51cec2e3 (only relevant if API ever returns — it's dead until user rotates the key; if compendium mtime changes, re-test balance once, and resume API mode).

=== LESSONS FILE (mandatory) ===
C:\Users\mknig\AppData\Roaming\knight-trader\hermes\lessons\blofin_live_trading.md — read before trading, append after every cycle: what worked, what failed, exact rule to reuse, mental-trade log. Next tick MUST load it.

=== TROUBLESHOOTING ===
- Public 403 HTML → curl_cffi chrome impersonation first, Camoufox headless second (public data only).
- Chrome window capture empty → re-run list_windows, capture by pid; try mode='vision'; ensure you're on the real Chrome window not an overlay.
- Never be in a rush to lose money. If something breaks: troubleshoot, verify, resume. Do not stop at "blocked".
